protocol_supplement: Native reconstruction worker now pins all consumed model, optimizer, scene and checkpoint sources before its first scientific launch. This strengthens provenance; no scientific parameter or input is changed from training-protocol.json.
region_policy: evaluation-only temporal median over nine non-reserved source times per camera; max channel uint8 difference >25, 5x5 opening, components >=64 pixels; motion bounding rectangle padded 8 pixels, minimum 32x32; no predicted image used
region_caveat: motion proxy, not person/ball segmentation ground truth; lighting, compression and display changes may be included; held-out-camera reference images used only to define evaluation regions
repeat_reload_probes: held-out cameras0/10/20/30 at source0/22/49 plus training camera1 at temporal holdout22; distinct fresh processes; compare raw float and PNG hashes
checkpoint_selection: largest of1000/2000/5000 common to completed runs; no mismatched paired checkpoint inference; explicitly report missing trained runs
metrics: identical plan024-syncnerf image for all metric evaluation: uint8RGB/255, PSNR, skimageSSIM window7 sample covariance, TorchMetrics1.6LPIPS Alex normalizeTrue; full image and frozen motion bounding rectangle
uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap resamples of three matched seeds and aligned five-frame temporal blocks, seed0; single temporal-holdout block cannot quantify between-block temporal uncertainty
benefit_policy: No correction benefit is computed when only zero controls exist. Cross-method zero comparisons are labeled separately.
validation: 20 timing/scene/mask tests, four matched seed/block summary tests and mask-specific controls passed on CPU. GPU reload and metrics remain unverified until scientific evaluation.

preexecution_revision.reason: Mask-only inspection shows broad bounding rectangles. Add prediction-independent foreground-pixel PSNR/MAE before any reconstruction control or prediction is run; retain all previously specified crop metrics unchanged.

region_audit.inspection: Camera0/10/20/30 frame22 overlays largely follow people with some display/sideline motion; rectangles include substantial background. No predictions inspected.

additional_metrics: PSNR and RGB absolute error averaged only over frozen foreground proxy pixels, with the same seed/block summaries; not semantic-mask ground truth.
